title: Refuse folder and pattern entries in where
what: Add `where_folders(where, repo) -> list[str]` to lib/relay_queue.py. It is called by `add` (about line 949) and by `edit` of the `where` field (about line 1894), and NOT by `where_problems`, which also runs inside `relay queue check` with no tree.

Refused: a path ending in `/`; a path naming an existing directory (also without a slash); a path containing `*`, `?` or `[`. A path that does not exist yet is accepted. Message example: "where element 2 `lib/` is a folder: name the file you will change (a new file is fine, e.g. lib/relay_cmd/digest.py)".

Tests in tests/test_queue_where.py (new), in a temporary repository: `lib/`, `docs` and `rules/*.md` are refused; `lib/relay_cmd/digest.py` and `lib/relay_queue.py:103` are accepted; `edit` gives the same verdicts; `relay queue check` stays green on a stored item with `lib/` (this test fails if the rule is put into where_problems). Rule-text cases: `add` with ["lib/relay_setup.py:325-333 merge_settings", "docs/handover.md"] is accepted; `add` with ["docs/"] is refused with the next step.

Rewrite the stored items: 24 open items have a folder entry, 6 entries are patterns. Fix each with one `relay queue edit` call, `because` = "folder entry named as a file"; a pattern becomes the files it covers today. Record which items the start filter holds before and after.

Rules text: rules/queue.md line 53 gets the example ["lib/relay_setup.py:325-333 merge_settings", "docs/handover.md"] and one sentence: "a folder, a directory name without a slash and a pattern are refused; name the file, a new one is fine." This makes the move a paid-path change (rules/**): it may wait at the landing while a paid run goes. Its hunk at line 53 does not overlap another lane's insert after line 46.
Done: the full gate is green, the tests above pass, the 24 items are rewritten, a refusal names the next step.

Traps for every move: keep imports lint-clean (ruff F); tests that import from the repo root must still run under the short gate; done items name their `test` ids, which are found by name, so do not rename tests; RULE_TESTS names in lib/relay_textonly.py must stay valid; tests never touch the live .relay/queue (use a temporary folder); a move that takes a function another lane changed ports that lane's hunk by hand; the size marker leaves a file in the move that brings it under 600 lines.
why: Move 1 of the split of relay into one module per subcommand. The owner decided it on 28 Oct: "каждая подкоманда может и должна жить в своем модуле, этот подход должен быть распространен на весь relay", and answered yes to refusing a folder as a where entry. The start filter holds an item when a running branch changed any file inside a folder named in its where: 13 of the 29 held items are held by folders.
pass_cases: a folder, a no-slash directory and a pattern are refused by add and edit with the next step
check stays green on stored items with a folder
dropped_why: Duplicate queued by mistake on 29 Oct: a worker ran relay queue add over old input files of moves 1-3 and fix F; the original item exists and is landed or in progress.
